== interventions (NOT chance) ==
[env] do +bedroom_motion
[env] do +no_followup
[env] do +hallway_motion +kettle_heard +day_question
[env] do +request_after_return(call_elena) +not_before_coffee
These beats were decided OUTSIDE the story's chances. [forced]: the
player chose it — tell it as the choice that was made, never as luck,
fate or the dice. [do]: an intervention, a what-if imposed on the
story — tell it as a supposition ("suppose…", "had…", "in this
telling…"). [env]: the world outside the rules moved (an arrival, a
clock, a sensor) — tell it as something that happened TO the story,
from outside, never as a character's doing. A [do +X]/[do -X] start
state was set by hand: say so.
Never present any of these as a character's spontaneous impulse
unless a rule's doc says so.

== the rules (with their approved doc comments) ==
catalog nina_book01_ch01 1.
provenance text "book-01:94e2c5829e6ebefa3bd41e35e513bba943dc8e12:C01" "2026-11-25".
layers (story).
stages (live).
namespace narrative produce (story).
type task {call_elena}.
pred bedroom_motion : narrative.
pred briefed(task) : narrative.
pred day_question : narrative.
pred discovery_deferred : narrative.
pred discovery_pending : narrative.
pred greeted : narrative.
pred greeting_available : narrative.
pred greeting_tentative : narrative.
pred greeting_withdrawn : narrative.
pred hallway_motion : narrative.
pred kettle_heard : narrative.
pred no_followup : narrative.
pred not_before_coffee : narrative.
pred reminded(task) : narrative.
pred reminder_morning(task) : narrative.
pred reminder_return(task) : narrative.
pred request_after_return(task) : narrative.
pred returned_from_appointment : narrative.
stage live {
  %% [B01-C01-S01] "Nina prepared a greeting."
  prepare_greeting [story] : bedroom_motion * greeting_available -o greeting_tentative.
  %% [B01-C01-S01] "She withdrew the greeting."
  withdraw_greeting [story] : greeting_tentative * no_followup -o greeting_available * greeting_withdrawn.
  %% [B01-C01-S02] "Now the evidence was considerably better."
  greet [story] : greeting_available * hallway_motion * kettle_heard -o greeted.
  %% [B01-C01-S02] "you promised yourself you'd call Elena."
  brief [story] : $greeted * day_question * $reminder_morning(T) -o briefed(T).
  %% [B01-C01-S03] "No. When I'm back from the appointment."
  reschedule [story] : reminder_morning(T) * request_after_return(T) -o reminder_return(T).
  %% [B01-C01-S03] "It belonged to a future event: his return."
  remind_on_return [story] : reminder_return(T) * returned_from_appointment -o reminded(T).
  %% [B01-C01-S04] "Not before coffee."
  defer_discovery [story] : discovery_pending * not_before_coffee -o discovery_deferred.
}

Now narrate this run, in at most 290 words.
